lines.text: Zophar the Naamathite calls Job's speech a stream of words and says Job claims he is pure.
Zophar wishes God would speak against Job and says God exacts less than his iniquity deserves.
Zophar says God's deep things are higher than the heavens and deeper than Abaddon.
Zophar says a witless man cannot become wise and tells Job to put away the staff in his hand.
Zophar says Job's life will be brighter than noonday, and the wicked will hope for their last breath.
